content:
Following yesterday's system update containing security fixes, Apple has now detailed the security content of Safari 26.6.1. Here are the details.

Codex appears multiple times in the CVE acknowledgments list

Apple updated the "Apple security releases" webpage today, detailing the bug fixes in Safari 26.6.1, which is now available for download on macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia.

According to the documentation, this update includes 22 CVEs, all related to WebKit, with two vulnerabilities being "processing specially crafted malicious web content may lead to memory corruption".

Worth noting is that, as with recent security updates, OpenAI Codex Security appears nine times in the list, further highlighting the increasingly important role of AI tools in identifying security vulnerabilities in Apple software.

The following is Apple's complete security content for Safari 26.6.1:

Safari 26.6.1 was released on August 18, 2026. WebKit Available for: macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash. Description: An out-of-bounds access issue was addressed by improving bounds checking. WebKit Bugzilla: 317632 CVE-2026-64784: Janggoon Lee (Out of Bounds), OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: Addressed by improving memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 313452 CVE-2026-43795: wwwlk WebKit Bugzilla: 318348 CVE-2026-65338: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content may lead to memory corruption. WebKit Bugzilla: 318405 CVE-2026-65341: Henock Habte WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improving locking. WebKit Bugzilla: 321480 CVE-2026-64782: Seonwook Kim, Shubham Chaskar, lattice, Josef Korbel WebKit Description: Addressed by improving input validation. WebKit Bugzilla: 321484 CVE-2026-64781: Thomas Guillem WebKit Description: Addressed by improving state management. Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed by improving memory management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316347 CVE-2026-64715: Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) (TrendAI Zero Day Initiative) WebKit Description: Addressed by improving checks. WebKit Bugzilla: 316918 CVE-2026-64780: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improving state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316791 CVE-2026-65334: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improving memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 317317 CVE-2026-43794: Dung Do (@_piers2) (Calif.io) WebKit Impact: Processing specially crafted malicious web content may lead to an unexpected app termination. WebKit Bugzilla: 313703 CVE-2026-64787: Sugiyama Sota, Shubham Chaskar WebKit History Impact: Visiting a specially crafted malicious website may leak sensitive information. WebKit Bugzilla: 315528 CVE-2026-64778: Mohit Negi WebKit Storage WebKit Bugzilla: 321485 CVE-2026-64779: Shubham Chaskar, Tommy DeVoss (Braze Security Team) (@thedawgyg) Additional acknowledgments WebKit We would like to thank Henock Habte for their assistance.
